candidate: <full commit hash of the code being accepted; only records may change after it>

review.reviewer: <the milestone reviewer: tool and context, e.g. codex exec in a fresh context>
review.model: <its model: review.second_model's final_model, else its model>
review.fallback: <only when the milestone review could not use review.second_model: why; otherwise leave this field out>
review.revision: <full commit hash it reviewed (the whole milestone diff)>
review.base: <only under review.cadence milestone: the full commit hash the reviewed diff starts from, at or before the commit where the trusted branch authorised the milestone; leave this field out when parts is used>

parts.base: <only under review.cadence milestone, when the diff outgrew one review: the first part's base is the one above, each later part's base is the revision of the part before, and the last part's revision is revision above; leave this field out otherwise>

deep_paths: <only under review.cadence milestone: every review.deep_paths glob a production path of the reviewed diff matches, its security focus>

fix_check.revision: <only after findings: full commit hash after revision above that the one fix check covers>
fix_check.report: <https link to the fix check's report>

review.report: <https link to the posted review report (templates/review.md)>

trial_environment.address: <the address the owner is given, as the acceptance package names it: a URL, or how a desktop or local production build is opened>
trial_environment.build: <the build the owner is given: its version, tag or commit>

walkthrough.address: <the address walked: trial_environment's, never a development server>
walkthrough.environment: <anything else about where it ran: the browser and its version, the automation>
walkthrough.walk_data: <separate (the walker's own demo accounts and business, a fresh one for each unguided pass) | reset (one shared dataset, reset or reseeded after the last walk, before the owner is told)>
walkthrough.first_load_seconds: <the first page's load time the walker measured, a number; over 5 is a finding, listed in deferred>
walkthrough.walker: <the trial-walker agent and its context identifier>

unguided.outcome: <its outcome sentence, all the walker read>
unguided.note: <where it got stuck: a finding to fix, or to list in deferred; optional when reached>

steps.step: <the trial step, as the owner will read it>
steps.scenario: <the scenario it walks, which unguided then lists>

deferred: <each item wf ci deferred to this acceptance, every accepted_findings entry of the milestone's tasks, each scenario still stuck (by its name) and a first load over 5 s (naming the first load), in plain words>
tests_changed: <each acceptance test changed in this milestone>
